releases.name: v0.7.6
releases.body:
## What's changed
* Now do Randomizer Update on second frame and on `Update`
* Randomizer now fixes issues with the Mapping Satellite in case planets venture too close
* Randomizer handles static bodies like the White Hole in a consistent way

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PacificEngine/OW_Randomizer/compare/0.7.5...0.7.6

releases.name: v0.7.4
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Random Planet values are now calculated rather than try until a good value is found
  * This prevent potential infinite loops
* If bad values are given to the randomizer, it will now log them
* Random values no longer have bias to get planets closer, and will use the full array available to them 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PacificEngine/OW_Randomizer/compare/0.7.3...0.7.4
